+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from ansible import constants as C
+from ansible.executor.task_queue_manager import DisplaySend, FinalQueue
+from ansible.plugins import strategy as strategy_module
+
+
+def test_send_display_preserves_method_and_arguments():
+    queue = MagicMock()
+    FinalQueue.send_display(queue, 'warning', 'queued warning', formatted=True)
+    result = queue.put.call_args.args[0]
+
+    queue.put.assert_called_once()
+    assert isinstance(result, DisplaySend)
+    assert result.method == 'warning'
+    assert result.args == ('queued warning',)
+    assert result.kwargs == {'formatted': True}
+
+
+def test_results_thread_deduplicates_worker_warnings_and_deprecations(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    display = strategy_module.display
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_warns', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, '_deprecations', {})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(display, 'columns', 80)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(C, 'DEPRECATION_WARNINGS', True)
+
+    results = [
+        DisplaySend('warning', 'queued warning'),
+        DisplaySend('warning', 'queued warning'),
+        DisplaySend('deprecated', 'queued deprecation', version='99.0'),
+        DisplaySend('deprecated', 'queued deprecation', version='99.0'),
+        strategy_module.StrategySentinel(),
+    ]
+    queue = MagicMock()
+    queue.get.side_effect = results
+    strategy_module.results_thread_main(SimpleNamespace(_final_q=queue))
+
+    output = capsys.readouterr()
+    assert output.out == ''
+    assert output.err.count('[WARNING]: queued warning') == 1
+    assert output.err.count('[DEPRECATION WARNING]: queued deprecation') == 1
